_note: Translate every string value. Keep keys, IDs, model names, numbers, units and markdown. Prompt text is not in this file and stays English.

boudoir.title: Boudoir & Bedroom
boudoir.intro: Soft light, one adult subject, a bed or chair, lingerie or a robe. The most forgiving NSFW category: start here to learn how a model handles skin, fabric and light.

lingerie.title: Lingerie & Fashion Editorial
lingerie.intro: Magazine-grade lingerie and swimwear shots. Name the fabric, the light and the lens; editorial language lifts the whole image.

fineart.title: Artistic Nude & Figure Study
fineart.intro: Nudity treated as art: sculpted light, silhouettes, classical poses, painterly styles. Shadows and composition do the censoring, so these also survive stricter platforms.

couples.title: Couples & Intimacy
couples.intro: Two consenting adults. Give each person a distinct outfit or color, describe where each one is, and keep the pose simple so bodies don't merge.

creator.title: Creator Content & Selfies
creator.intro: Phone-camera looks for adult creators: mirror selfies, ring light, casual bedroom and gym shots. Realism comes from imperfection: slight grain, mixed light, everyday rooms.

fantasy.title: Fantasy, Sci-Fi & Cosplay
fantasy.intro: Adult fantasy characters and cosplay. Costume materials and one magical or tech element carry the image; keep every character explicitly adult.

anime.title: Anime & Illustration (Qwen Image 2.1 LoRA)
anime.intro: Anime, hentai-style and illustrated stills using Qwen Image 2.1 LoRA with open anime LoRAs. Every character is an adult design with adult proportions. Start the prompt with the LoRA's style phrase.

male.title: Male Boudoir & Fitness
male.intro: Adult men: boudoir, fitness, editorial. The same rules apply: one clear pose, named light, a real setting.

poster.title: Covers, Posters & Lettering
poster.intro: Adult magazine covers, calendar pages and posters where the text has to read correctly. Put the exact words in quotes and say where they go.

edit.title: Uncensored Image Editing Prompts
edit.intro: Instructions for Qwen Image 2.1 Edit: change an outfit, relight, move the scene, restyle, or build a consistent series from reference images. Only edit images of yourself, of consenting adults, or of fictional characters you generated. Never 'undress' a photo of a real person.
